generation.scope: On every component, if all corners of a finite regular window satisfy four-matrix identities and one satisfies three-matrix identities, the window is ordinary Clifford, without any semiprimeness assumption. All balanced size-three simples are vertex-orthogonal. Under the four-matrix bound a single vertex-orthogonal nonthin simple forces all vertex extensions to vanish and the window to be a center-finite domain. The proof uses finite projective resolutions of periodic tails and a three-block chain ending at any prescribed vertex.

open_mathematics: For the four-matrix residual, all nonthin simples must now have size two, one-sided nonzero vertex extensions, and be linked to every thin point. Analyze this case and the high-rank finite components with other PI bounds or no PI identity.
